faq_a1: AM IPTV works on all Samsung Smart TVs with Tizen OS (2016 and newer). You install the app via our guide sent by email.
faq_q2: Do I need an IPTV provider?
faq_a2: Yes. AM IPTV is a player app; you need your own M3U playlist or Xtream Codes account from a provider of your choice.
faq_q3: How do I receive my license key?
faq_a3: Immediately after payment, your license key is shown in your dashboard and you receive a confirmation email.
faq_q4: Can I use the app on multiple TVs?
faq_a4: Each license is valid for one Samsung TV. Additional TVs require additional subscriptions.
faq_a5: Our support team is available 24/7 at support@amiptv.tv. Priority support is included in the 1-Year and Unlimited plans.
